messages:
anya: quick note — onboarding hit: Go generator stalls when creds rotate mid-stream in our sample app.

ben: short repro?

anya: create gen with req ctx, spawn goroutine to call Next() and write tokens. background refresher calls client.UpdateToken which may rebuild transport. Next() yields an empty part then blocks forever. handler exits, goroutine leaks.

clare: does UpdateToken close connections? if so reader may never get an error.

anya: logs show repeated "read 0 bytes" then silence. no error bubbles.

ben: UX fixes: 1) expose Gen.Interrupt() that forcibly unblocks Next() immediately; 2) keep Close() for graceful drain; 3) have UpdateToken mark in-flight streams stale so Next() returns ErrAuthRotated.

clare: add docs snippet recommending creating a child ctx and deferring Interrupt() in handlers to avoid leaks. also add a tiny e2e that simulates token rotation and asserts deterministic errors.

ci-bot: opened issue #5342: "go-sdk: generator interrupt + auth-rotation e2e" and linked thread.

anya: thanks — this was blocking the quickstart sample. will validate once patches land. :+1:
